source.title: Ulster Herald, 26 April 1930, p. 5 ("Cookstown Rural Council")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 'The new unopposed nominations were—Messrs. B. A. M'Geagh (U.), for Lissin; J. L. Berkeley (U.), Grange; James Doris (N.), Mullinahoe; Patrick J. Duffy (N.), Killycoply; and D. Hutchinson (U.), Tullyhogue' (Ulster Herald, 26 April 1930, p. 5, read on the block image)

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Wednesday 4 June 1930 and counted at the council boardroom on the morning of 5 June (queue nominal 29 May). Munterevlin was the only contest in the district; the other divisions were returned unopposed and their names are not printed in the reports traced. Filed on 1930-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Tyrone that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1930-06-05 (verification 5 Nov 2026). The five new members returned unopposed are added from the Ulster Herald of 26 April 1930, p. 5; the re-nominated outgoing members are not named there (6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
